portable_goal: Install and run the AI-Scientist-style Web 2D game generation skill on another Codex machine with graceful dependency degradation.
video_generation_policy: Volcengine Seedance and other video generation services are optional. If the user wants to open/login/authorize Volcengine, use it and record task id plus provenance. If no video generator is available, skip video generation and continue with a static background.
fallback_policy: Missing external generators or public benchmark runners must be reported as disabled or SKIPPED_NO_SCORE; do not fabricate official scores, task ids, videos, or provenance.
